personality_one_liner: A precision device utility command center delivering clinical battery health insights, live power telemetry, and non-alarmist cycle tracking with zero visual clutter.

spacing.rule: Generous and operational padding: compact headers, touch-friendly 56pt rows, pinned bottom CTAs with safe area clearance.

do's: Use crisp dividers and tonal surface separation for high data density readability
Keep telemetry graphs high-contrast and glanceable
dont's: Do not use heavy blur or glass effects that reduce telemetry glanceability in low light

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Primary command center featuring live battery percentage, charging/discharging state, voltage, temperature, and modular quick stats.

states.loading: Centered pulse spinner over obsidian surface with skeleton metric cards
states.empty: Clean diagnostic prompt with retry trigger if battery metrics fail to bind
states.error: Readable telemetry error banner with instant retry action

screens.layout: Vertical scroll container with top live status card, grid of quick telemetry widgets (Voltage, Temp, Power, Health), live charging curve graph preview, and sticky alert ticker.

screens.name: Timeline
screens.purpose: Unified charge and discharge session history with granular timestamps and event tags.

states.loading: Skeleton list rows simulating charging intervals
states.empty: Battery outline icon + 'No charging sessions recorded yet. Plug in your device to begin tracking.' + 'Start Test Session' CTA
states.error: Failed to read usage stats notification with refresh button

screens.layout: Chronological session stream with collapsible day/week grouping, visual charge-speed indicators, and quick-note tag pills.

screens.name: Analytics
screens.purpose: Raw-sample charge/discharge curves, battery health trends, and daily/weekly/monthly digests.

states.empty: Graph icon + 'Accumulating power data. Check back after your first full charge cycle.'
states.error: Chart rendering error indicator with retry

screens.layout: Tabbed analytics views (24h curve, 30-day health trend, digest stats) with interactive scrubber points and confidence labels.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: Customizable dashboard cards, charging alert thresholds, sound cue settings, always-on status mode, and CSV export.
screens.layout: Categorized preference list with switches for sound cues, always-on display simulation, alert percentage sliders, and CSV export action.

hero_battery_ambient.alt: Minimalist abstract dark tech glow representing battery health

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement CycleSense as an Android-first Expo React Native app using Personality 7 (Dark-First Utility DARK) with warm ember/signal orange accent (#FF6B2B) and obsidian background (#121417). Support capability-aware graceful fallbacks for native modules (BatteryManager, UsageStatsManager, WorkManager, SoundPool, Always-On Display, Glance widgets) so the UI remains robust and responsive in Expo Go. Include live battery metrics (percentage, charging/discharging state, voltage, temperature, current draw, health score out of 10), unified charge/discharge timeline with notes/tags, raw-sample curve graphs, battery health trend charts, daily/weekly/monthly digests, customizable dashboard cards, charging alerts with sound cue toggles, CSV export, confidence labels for estimates, and non-alarmist observations. Ensure touch targets are >= 44x44pt, typography weights do not exceed 500 except for condensed display numbers, and state management handles loading, empty, and error views correctly across all screens.
